title: DMW ready for possible evacuation, repatriation amid France, Italy protests
summary: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is prepared for possible evacuation and repatriation of Filipinos amid protests in France and Italy, Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac assured on Wednesday.
